exceptions.rationale: Ubuntu 24.04 has no fixed util-linux package as of the 2026-07-16 review. The flaw requires a local user to race a setuid mount helper; these base packages cannot be removed without breaking the supported Ubuntu runtime.
compensating_controls: The image removes the setuid bit from both mount helpers and verifies that removal during the build.
Production runs as uid 10001 with all capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges, AppArmor, seccomp, and a read-only root filesystem.

exceptions.rationale: Ubuntu 24.04 has no fixed Avahi package as of the 2026-07-16 review. The flaw is a local denial of service in avahi-daemon, while only client libraries pulled by the browser's CUPS dependency are present.
compensating_controls: The image does not install avahi-daemon and verifies its absence during the build, so the affected server and local socket do not exist.
The production egress boundary denies direct private, link-local, metadata, and multicast access.

exceptions.rationale: Ubuntu 24.04 has no fixed glibc package as of the 2026-07-16 review. The flaw is restricted to IBM1390 and IBM1399 iconv conversion modules that Scrapeyard does not support.
compensating_controls: The image removes both affected gconv modules and verifies they are absent during the build.
The request and fetched-content budgets bound processing time and memory independently.

exceptions.rationale: Ubuntu 24.04 has no fixed glibc package as of the 2026-07-16 review. The affected gethostbyaddr reverse-lookup path is not used by Scrapeyard's connected-IP validation.
compensating_controls: Scrapeyard authorizes the actual connected peer IP without reverse DNS and revalidates every redirect.
Production requires a trustworthy egress-filtering proxy and denies direct private, metadata, and link-local destinations.

exceptions.rationale: Ubuntu 24.04 has no fixed glibc package as of the 2026-07-16 review. Scrapeyard and its locked Python dependencies do not call the deprecated ns_printrrf, ns_printrr, or fp_nquery debug APIs.
compensating_controls: DNS use is constrained to supported resolver APIs and the mandatory production egress proxy boundary.

exceptions.rationale: Ubuntu 24.04 has no fixed Expat package as of the 2026-07-16 review. Scrapeyard does not parse fetched web content with Expat; the library is retained by the supported Python/browser runtime.
compensating_controls: Untrusted scrape configuration uses the bounded YAML loader, and fetched DOM processing uses the separately sandboxed browser or lxml path.
Request size, fetched bytes, elapsed time, memory, and concurrency are bounded.

exceptions.rationale: Ubuntu 24.04 has no fixed p11-kit package as of the 2026-07-16 review. The flaw requires local access to the p11-kit server RPC socket; only the client library is installed transitively.
compensating_controls: The image does not install the p11-kit server package and verifies its absence during the build, so the affected RPC socket is unavailable.
The container exposes no shell or local multi-user boundary and runs as a dedicated uid with no-new-privileges.

exceptions.rationale: Ubuntu 24.04 and Trivy publish no fixed pixman package as of the 2026-07-16 review. Pixman is required by the supported headful browser/Xvfb path and cannot be removed without dropping Camoufox functionality.
compensating_controls: Browser content executes as uid 10001 inside the browser sandbox with AppArmor, seccomp, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges, and a read-only root filesystem.
Browser task concurrency, memory, elapsed time, screenshots, and debug artifact sizes are bounded.
